records.title: PyraTok: Language-Aligned Pyramidal Tokenizer for Video Understanding and Generation
records.reason: The full text uses hierarchical quantization/codebooks for video and reports tokenizer/generation quality and tokenization cost. It does not demonstrate an end-to-end LLM/VLM inference latency or serving reduction; the tokenizer-to-multimodal inference connection is plausible but unquantified.

records.title: The DNA dialect: a comprehensive guide to pretrained genomic language models
records.reason: The publisher abstract is a review of pretrained genomic language models and DNA sequence modeling.

records.title: Silence the Judge: Reinforcement Learning with Self-Verifier via Latent Geometric Clustering
records.reason: The arXiv abstract presents latent-geometric clustering for self-verifier reinforcement learning.

records.title: Intelligence Degradation in Long-Context LLMs: Critical Threshold Determination via Natural Length Distribution Analysis
records.reason: The arXiv abstract measures degradation in long-context LLMs and estimates critical context thresholds.

records.title: Window-based Membership Inference Attacks Against Fine-tuned Large Language Models
records.reason: The full text develops a privacy attack and reports attack runtime/overhead. The measured efficiency is attack-side computation rather than improvement to target-model inference or serving; the linked LLM lineage does not change this scope distinction.
